messages:
Aisha Patel: Morning — quick heads up: I started intake for a new 7B->4-bit quant experiment (alpine-fork). Need a lightweight QA gate before we let it hit dedicated pools. Proposed minimal gate below:

```
- smoke eval on 500 prompt slices (mix: synthetic + sampled prod prompts)
- pass if avg perplexity change < 10% AND exact-match drop < 3 points on synth bench
- safety: toxic-flag regressions <= 0.1% absolute
- latency: p95 <= baseline * 1.25
- hallucination: binary fail if hallucination rate increases > 5% absolute
```

Can we align on numbers and the run plan? Planning to kick an initial harness tonight for a quick sanity run.
more_messages:
Tom Nguyen: Love the checklist. Quick q: 'perplexity change' — are we using token_xent->ppl from the harness or an LM-scored ppl? Also which baseline exactly (fp16 prod or the stable release tag)?

Marco Li: Use ppl computed by the eval harness (token_xent -> ppl). Baseline should be the latest stable release tag (release/v2.8). For latency, run the comparison on the same infra configuration.

Lina Gomez: Add a 'sensitive' subset (legal + medical + finance) — maybe ~200 prompts — to make sure worst-case safety is covered. Also include a rerank stability check (top-1/top-3 shifts).

Aisha Patel: Good call on sensitive subset. I'll include it and add rerank pass criteria: top-1 delta < 2% absolute.

Tom Nguyen: Example harness command so CI/bots can pick it up?

Aisha Patel: Run this locally or on the harness VM:

```
./eval_harness \n  --model=redwood/alpine-fork:quant-4bit \n  --prompts=bench_mix.jsonl \n  --sensitive=subset_sensitive.jsonl \n  --metrics=ppl,exact_match,rerank_acc,toxicity,latency,hallucination_rate \n  --out=results/quant4b_run.json
```

eval-bot will queue it automatically when posted to the job queue.

eval-bot: Job queued (job_id=2026031401). Notifying @Marco @Tom on completion.

Marco Li: I'll kick a tiny smoke job (100 prompts) first to sanity-check output format and metrics. If OK, I'll launch the full 500 prompt run.

(eval-bot later): eval-bot: Job complete — results uploaded to gs://redwood-eval/quant4b_run.json. Quick summary: ppl +8.0%, exact-match -1.8 pts, rerank_top1 -0.5 pts, toxic_flag +0.02% absolute, p95 latency +12%, hallucination_rate +0.6% absolute.

Tom Nguyen: Those numbers look within the proposed thresholds: ppl +8% <10%, EM drop -1.8 <3, tox +0.02% <0.1, p95 +12% <25%. Halucination +0.6% is <5% but let's eyeball the failure modes. Need a quick manual pass on high-risk prompts.

Lina Gomez: I'll sample 50 hallucination-sensitive prompts and do a manual review. Will upload annotated examples to the ticket and tag the thread.

Aisha Patel: Decision for now: pass smoke QA gate. Plan: canary rollout — dedicated pool with 2 nodes, canary window 24h, monitor metrics and auto-rollback triggers: >3 customer-facing errors / min(2% absolute hallucination increase, or 5% traffic-level error rate).

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-15T21:00Z (canary_id=c-20260315-03).

Tom Nguyen: I'll update the intake ticket with pass metrics, attach harness artifacts and the GS link. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
